meta.notes: Training 2, hands: the kitchen court. A cook at his table behind a wall with a hatch, a baker at the tandoor, a watchman on the one gap; the cook's store with the ration book. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts train-hands

steps.line: E puts it away. A grab needs empty hands
Go in quietly. Stop at the hatch in the wall
V whistles the cook out. Then hide at once, at the mark
Hide at the mark now: he comes round by the gate
Keep still. He comes to the hatch and looks
He has given up. Round behind him: Space at his back
Space asks him. Keep asking until he gives up his key
Right button chokes him out. Then keep still
Space at the body takes hold of him
Get him into the wood store, out of sight. Space lets him go
At the tandoor: Right button at his back knocks him out
The last man watches the gap. Q in the dark corner beside it
V whistles him over. Keep still: let him come through
As he comes through, step in: Left button. The knife kills
The store is locked. Space at its door
Tap Space at the blue trunk, then keep still
